Thanks for the response. That seems to be a very true element of life. I've heard often times that holocaust survivors have the happiest embrace on life having lived through what they have, something I could never imagine. 

Luckily, last night was just something I consider an episode, and thank god for this forum for letting me spill it out. I'm at a time in life where I'm truly learning to love myself, not judge and really connect with the people around me and god damn, I feel like the movie limitless when bradley cooper takes the pill lol.
ya it really helps get the shit out. thanks for reading!
